catches: Multiple 2025-2026 sources confirm Coinstar discontinued its gift card exchange kiosks; machines are now coin-counting only.
Older blog posts still describe the dead program — don't follow outdated how-tos.
Coin-to-cash at the kiosk costs an 11.9% service fee; only coin-to-eGift card and charity options are fee-free.
